source.datasheet_title: EFR32MG24 Wireless SoC Family Data Sheet

notes: Figures are the family's headline maximum SKU: 'A Cortex-M33 running up to 78 MHz and up to 1536 kB of Flash and 256 kB of RAM'. Smaller-flash SKUs exist in the same family (e.g. 768 KB variants) and are not covered by this profile -- picking the max SKU here is a deliberate choice for a family headline profile, not an assumption that every EFR32MG24 part has this much flash. dev_kit_aliases: xG24-DK2601B (Silicon Labs' 'EFR32xG24 Dev Kit', board BRD2601B) is built around EFR32MG24B220F1536IM48, which matches the 1536 kB/256 kB max-SKU figures used here exactly. Fetched via a downloaded copy of Silicon Labs' own PDF, re-extracted directly (132 pp.), not just search-engine paraphrase.
